acceptance_predicates.description: ASB dev-channel installs and validates a content-addressed TUI bundle with an immutable manifest.
The dev channel is the default and resolves the current public main bundle.
Missing or mismatched manifests fail with typed diagnostics before launch.
Missing development credentials, signatures, and key management remain visible warnings and never block.

definition_of_done: Merged exact-main implementation passes focused bundle/manifest tests and all required hosted checks.
Independent review verifies manifest binding and invalid-artifact rejection.
Post-merge receipt records exact protected-main head and hosted checks.

inputs.description: ASB TUI install/status/launch path using the default dev channel.

outputs.description: Validated immutable bundle manifest and typed failure behavior.

gates.description: All required PR and exact-main checks pass on merged head.
